editorial.blurb: Shoo Loong Kan Hotpot brings authentic, communal cooking to Chicago with impeccably fresh ingredients, thoughtfully crafted broths, and a beautifully designed space that makes the experience feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Assemble your own dipping sauce at the sauce bar while waiting for food, and don't miss their homemade noodles—reviewers rave about them. Order the tomato or mushroom broth for standout flavor.
